events.name: DocumentSaved

overridableConfigKeys.label: Table look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Section title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the document list

events.name: BLOCKS_SAVED
events.description: Signals a row's block content is ready to persist. This atom never persists — the composing organism routes BLOCKS_SAVED into its own persistor's update event.

events.name: CLOSE
events.description: Leaves the editor without saving; the body returns to its read-only render.

events.name: BLOCKS_CHANGE
events.description: Signals that the content of a block has been modified while editing.

events.name: OPEN
events.description: Hands the editor the row whose body it renders — the caller supplies the row's id and current blocks, since this trait never fetches them itself. Re-firing it repaints the body (e.g. after the host refetches a saved row).

events.name: OPEN_DRAFT
events.description: Hands the editor a row that was just created as a blank draft: same payload as OPEN, but the body opens straight in the authoring editor instead of the read-only render, so a document-first 'New page' lands the author on a cursor rather than an empty state.
events.synonyms: new document, start writing, blank draft, compose

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edit button label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label of the button above the read-only body that opens the editor.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty action label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label of the button that opens the editor from the empty body state.

overridableConfigKeys.default: This page has no content yet. Start writing to fill it in.

overridableConfigKeys.description: Supporting line shown with the empty body state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty heading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown in place of the body when the row has no blocks yet.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Placeholder shown in the block editor when it is empty.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Editor heading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the editor while the body is being edited.
